sentences: An early read-before-write analysis over all compute and mesh shaders found **compute** v0 (880), v0–v1 (614), v0–v2 (50), consistent with AMD's local thread ID x/y/z in v0/v1/v2, and scalar inputs centred on a pointer at s[4:5] and s6/s7.
**Mesh:** every one of 2,969 reads exactly **v5**, plus s3 (always arithmetic), s[16:17] and s19–s23.

The early pass also read FSSM 0x13C as the group width and compared the first SGPR multiply against it (82 match, 151 don't, 1,447 no simple multiply) and wrongly concluded that 0x13C was not the group width; the matching register varied by shader (s6/s10/s7/s9…).
PSV0 gave the real thread-group sizes (32×1×1 for 1,253, 8×8×1 for 416, …).

**Superseded:** 0x13C/0x140/0x144 are the thread-group size, `COMPUTE_PGM_RSRC2` at 0x138 gives the per-shader user-SGPR count and enabled workgroup IDs, and mesh takes NumThreads, limits and topology from PSV0 with `v5 = linearGroupIndex * NumThreads + LocalInvocationIndex`.
All 2,689 CS and 9,282 mesh shaders translate now (see the Compute shaders and Mesh shaders rows).
